translationRepairs: About then Yizhou Inspector Xi Jian was grinding the people with heavy levies until rumor of it spread far; Xi Jian was a descendant of Xi Zheng.
About then Yizhou Inspector Xi Jian was grinding the people with heavy levies until rumor of it spread far; Xi Jian was an ancestor of Xi Zheng.
儉，郤正祖也 identifies Jian as Xi Zheng's ancestor (祖); “descendant” reverses the kinship, and the proposed “ancestor” restores the Chinese direction.
It happened that Inspector of Yizhou Xi Jian levied taxes in vexing and harassing fashion, and rumors were heard from afar; Jian was a descendant of Xi Zheng.
It happened that Inspector of Yizhou Xi Jian levied taxes in vexing and harassing fashion, and rumors were heard from afar; Jian was the ancestor of Xi Zheng.
The same clause 儉，郤正祖也 marks Jian as Xi Zheng's ancestor, not descendant; the literal repair correctly restores that kinship direction.

After Liu Bei conquered Shu, Pang Xi served as major to the general of the left. Liu Zhang had prevailed on Pang Xi to keep Liu Xun in the west, and Liu Bei then commissioned Liu Xun as gentleman of the household for the chariot.

After Liu Bei conquered Shu, Pang Xi served as major to the general of the left. Liu Zhang at that time followed Pang Xi's petition to keep Liu Xun, and Liu Bei then commissioned Liu Xun as gentleman of the household for the chariot.
璋時從羲啟留循 means Zhang followed Pang Xi's petition to keep Xun; “had prevailed on Pang Xi” reverses agency, and the proposed wording restores the Chinese subject and 從羲啟.
Some manuscripts read “Liu Guang” here instead of the name in the following line.
The Chinese unit is only the parenthetical （劉光）; the idiomatic before invents a manuscript explanation absent from this line, and “(Liu Guang)” matches the source form (and the existing literal).
